_comment: Hand-derived ground truth for the assignment's two schemas, written from the
schemas directly rather than from pipeline output, so it can disagree with the
pipeline. Shape tests prove the output is well formed; this proves it is right.
Counts: 34 source columns (19 + 7 + 8), 40 destination leaf paths (25 + 7 + 8),
33 mappings, 1 justified unmapped source field, 7 unmapped destination paths.
Container objects (fullName, employment, compensation, contact, department,
location, meta) are not destinations and are excluded from the 40.

unmapped_source_fields.dob: The destination employee document has no birth-date path anywhere; date of birth is simply not carried over.

unmapped_destination_fields.department.code: Denormalized copy of dept_info.dept_cd, populated by joining dept_info during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.department.name: Denormalized copy of dept_info.dept_nm, populated by joining dept_info during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.location.code: Denormalized copy of locations.loc_cd, populated by joining locations during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.location.name: Denormalized copy of locations.loc_nm, populated by joining locations during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.location.city: Denormalized copy of locations.city, populated by joining locations during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.location.country: Denormalized copy of locations.country_cd, populated by joining locations during migration.
unmapped_destination_fields.location.timezone: Denormalized copy of locations.tz_cd, populated by joining locations during migration.

_transform_comment: Transforms the pipeline must get right, checked by substring rather than exact
wording so the model keeps its own voice. 'notes_required' means notes must not
be null, because a silent cast would hide real migration work.
